description: This Java class 'LayoutChangesActivity' demonstrates the use of system-provided automatic layout transitions in Android. It allows adding and removing list items with animated transitions within a ViewGroup, specifically a LinearLayout, and manages menu options for interaction.

classes.name: LayoutChangesActivity
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating animated layout changes with add/remove item functionality.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and references container view.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for navigation and adding items.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Creates a new list item view, assigns random country text, sets delete button listener, and adds it to the container with animation.
